Faculty of Mathematics and Natural SciencesPhD Student Position (f/m/x) in “Quantum Hall calorimetry of quantum materials“Institute of Physics II | Bocquillon Working GroupWe are one of the largest and oldest universities in Europe and one of the most important employers in our region. Our broad range of subjects, the dynamic development of our main research areas and our central location in Cologne make us attractive for students and researchers from around the world. We offer a wide range of career opportunities in science, technology, and administration.One PhD Student position is available in the group of Professor Erwann Bocquillon, which specializes in the quantum transport of quantum materials(https://ph2.uni-koeln.de/en/research-groups/bocquillon).The University of Cologne promotes equal opportunities and diversity. The reference number is Wiss2610-07. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comTasks & responsibilities- Contribute to BIVF's investment strategy and thematic priorities, informed by emerging scientific, technology, market and financing trends.- Proactively source high-quality opportunities through relationships with entrepreneurs, biotech executives, academics, venture investors, technology transfer offices and other innovation partners.- Lead the scientific, strategic, commercial and financial assessment of potential investments, including company, asset, market, competitive, financing and exit considerations.- Build and coordinate cross-functional due diligence teams; translate findings into clear investment theses, key risks, value-creation plans and recommendations for the Investment Committee.- Develop financing strategies and financial models; assess capitalization, ownership, dilution, syndicate composition and future funding needs; negotiate term sheets, governance rights and transaction documentation.- Prepare high-quality investment papers and present opportunities and recommendations to senior stakeholders and the Investment Committee.- Actively manage portfolio companies, including serving as Board Director or Board Observer where appropriate, and support strategy, financing, organizational development, partnering and exit planning.- Monitor portfolio performance and risks, support follow-on and business development decisions, connect companies with relevant Boehringer Ingelheim expertise, and represent BIVF as a trusted, value-adding syndicate partner while maintaining rigorous governance, compliance and professional standards.Requirements- Advanced degree, preferably a PhD or MD, in biology, biochemistry, chemistry, bioengineering, medicine or a related discipline, combined with a strong understanding of pharmaceutical drug discovery and development.- Strong therapeutic biotech judgment, including the ability to assess scientific quality, target selection, molecule design, translational relevance, development risk, unmet medical need, competitive positioning and value inflection points across indications.- Several years of hands-on venture capital experience in therapeutic biotech or life sciences, with direct involvement in sourcing, due diligence, transaction execution and oversight of company leadership. This is not an entry-level venture capital role.- Established network among European life-science investors, entrepreneurs, biotech executives and innovation stakeholders, with demonstrated ability to originate opportunities and build high-quality syndicates.- Demonstrated transaction and analytical capabilities, including evaluation of business plans and financing strategies, financial and ownership analysis, investment structuring, and negotiation with companies and co-investors.- Ability to lead multidisciplinary diligence teams, influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex scientific and investment topics clearly and credibly.- Experience working with venture-backed boards, founders or management teams; Board Director or Board Observer experience, company creation, incubation or management-team building is advantageous.- Fluency in English and willingness to travel regularly across Europe and internationally; experience in BD&L, external innovation, strategic partnering or alliance transactions is advantageous.What We OfferWith us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? jobs.description: With about 15,000 students, more than 300 professorships and around 160 degree programs, the RPTU University Kaiserslautern-Landau is the technical university of the state of Rhineland-Palatinate. As a place of top international research, it offers excellent working conditions and career opportunities. Those who study, research or work at RPTU experience a cosmopolitan environment and shape the future.The Media Psychology Research Group (headed by Prof. Dr. Stephan Winter) is seeking a Research Associate (TV-L 13, 75% of full-time employment) for the DFG-funded project „Do your own research! Benefits of social media usage for conspiracy believers and the interplay of selectivity and persuasive media effects”. The project is part of the DFG Research Unit "Beyond Crazy: Integrating Benefits into the Analysis of Conspiracy Beliefs” and is therefore embedded in a larger interdisciplinary research network. This includes regular academic exchange with doctoral researchers and professors at the other participating institutions, as well as participation in joint conferences and workshops. Candidates who wish to apply for positions in multiple subprojects within the Research Unit are encouraged to do so and are asked to indicate this in their respective applications.Your area of responsibility:- Designing and conducting empirical studies (e.g., experiments and web/mobile tracking studies)- Preparing manuscripts for publication in academic journals- Presenting research findings at academic conferences- Collaborating on research activities within the DFG Research Unit “Beyond Crazy: Integrating Benefits into the Analysis of Conspiracy Beliefs”- The position provides the opportunity to pursue an academic qualification, in particular the completion of a doctoral dissertation.Your requirements profile:- An excellent Master's degree in Psychology or Communication Science- Strong interest in media psychology research and current developments in the media landscape as well as in research on conspiracy beliefs- Experience in conducting empirical studies (ideally involving experiments, surveys, or tracking data)- Very good command of English- Knowledge of German is of advantageFind more informations on our homepage:https://jobs.rptu.de/jobposting/df7dca5afad2abd23253464bf13f750597c47c8c0 (https://jobs.rptu.de/jobposting/df7dca5afad2abd23253464bf13f750597c47c8c0)We look forward to receiving your detailed application (CV, references, etc.) by 29.11.2026 at the latest.

Universität Paderborn ist eine leistungsstarke und international orientierte Campus-Universität. In interdisziplinären Teams gestalten wir zukunftsweisende Forschung, innovative Lehre sowie den aktiven Wissenstransfer in die Gesellschaft. Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft!In der Fakultät für Elektrotechnik, Informatik und Mathematik ist am Institut für Informatik – Fachgruppe Rechnerarchitektur – zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine Stelle alswissenschaftliche*r Mitarbeiter*in (w/m/d)(Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L)im Umfang von 100 % der regelmäßigen Arbeitszeit zu besetzen. Es handelt sich um eine Qualifizierungsstelle im Sinne des Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetzes (WissZeitVG), die zur Förderung eines Promotionsverfahrens oder zur Qualifizierung in Hinblick auf eine wissenschaftliche Karriere in der Postdoktorandenphase dient. Die Stelle ist befristet, abhängig von der bisher erreichten Qualifizierung, jedoch für einen Zeitraum von i. d. R. 3 Jahren, zu besetzen. Eine Verlängerung ist innerhalb der Befristungsgrenzen des WissZeitVG ggf. möglich.Die Forschungsgruppe unter der Leitung von Prof. Dr.-Ing. Asif Ali Khan arbeitet an der Schnittstelle zwischen neuartigen Rechnerarchitekturen und Compilern und nutzt dabei sowohl herkömmliche als auch neuartige nichtflüchtige Speichertechnologien. Zu den Forschungsgebieten zählen In-Memory- und Near-Memory-Computing sowie die Entwicklung von Modellierungs- und Simulationsframeworks und von Leistungs- und Genauigkeitsmodellen für diese neuartigen Systeme. Die Gruppe interessiert sich insbesondere für das Hardware/Software Co-Design sowie für schichtübergreifende Optimierungen (Cross-Stack-Optimisierungen) für Anwendungsbereiche, die maschinelles Lernen umfassen, aber auch darüber hinausgehen.Aufgabenbereich:• Wissenschaftliche Forschung im weiteren Bereich neuartiger Rechnerarchitekturen unter Einsatz konventioneller und neuer Technologien• Veröffentlichung, Präsentation und Verbreitung von Forschungsergebnissen• Lehrverpflichtung im Umfang von i. d. R. 4 SWSEinstellungsvoraussetzungen:• Überdurchschnittlicher wissenschaftlicher Hochschulabschluss (Master oder vergleichbar) in Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Mathematik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet• Abgeschlossene Promotion für die Einstellung als Postdoc• Erfahrung in der Modellierung und Simulation auf Schaltungsebene (z. B. SPICE), idealerweise für „Compute-in-Memory“-Architekturen (CIM) oder unkonventionelle Rechenparadigmen wie probabilistisches Rechnen (p-Bits)• Kenntnisse über neue Bautechnologien (z. B. nichtflüchtige Speicher) und deren Bauteil- und Schaltungsmodelle• Erfahrung in den Bereichen Computerarchitektur sowie Modellierungs- und Simulationswerkzeuge (z. B. gem5)Erwartet wird:• Eigenständigkeit und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise• Bereitschaft zur Zusammenarbeit und zum Arbeiten in einem vielfältigen Umfeld, auch bei Themen, die über Ihr Hauptforschungsgebiet hinausgehen• Fließende EnglischkenntnisseWir bieten Ihnen:• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung sowie die individuelle Möglichkeit zur mobilen Arbeit• Vielzahl von Gesundheits-, Beratungs- und Präventionsangeboten• Attraktive Nebenleistungen wie Kinderbetreuungsmöglichkeiten und Sportangebote• Möglichkeit zur internen und externen Fort- und Weiterbildung• Zusätzliche Leistungen nach dem Tarifvertrag der Länder (TV-L) wie Jahressonderzahlung und vermögenswirksame Leistungen sowie die Zusatzversorgung der VBL• Möglichkeit eigene Themen und Forschungsfragen im thematischen Rahmen zu finden und zu untersuchenBewerbungen von Frauen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht und werden gem. Ebenso ist die Bewerbung geeigneter Schwerbehinderter und Gleichgestellter im Sinne des Sozialgesetzbuches Neuntes Buch (SGB IX) erwünscht.Bewerbungen mit den üblichen Unterlagen werden unter Angabe der Kennziffer 7442 bis zum 26. November 2026 erbeten an eim-i-gs@uni-paderborn.de.Informationen zur Verarbeitung Ihrer personenbezogenen Daten finden Sie unter: www.uni-paderborn.de/zv/personaldatenschutz.Prof. Dr.-Ing. Asif Ali KhanFakultät für Elektrotechnik, Informatik und MathematikUniversität PaderbornWarburger Str. 10033098 PaderbornPaderborn University is a high-performance and internationally oriented university. Within interdisciplinary teams, we undertake forward-looking research, design innovative teaching concepts and actively transfer knowledge into society. As an important research and cooperation partner, the university also shapes regional development strategies. We offer our employees in research, teaching, technology and administration a lively, family-friendly and equal opportunity environment, a lean management structure and diverse opportunities. Join us to invent the future!In the Faculty of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematics at the Department of Computer Science – Research Group Computer Architecture – the following position is to be filled as soon as possible:Research Assistant (f/m/d)(Salary level according to 13 TV-L)with 100 % of the regular working hours. This is a qualification position within the meaning of the German Act on Fixed-Term Research Employment Contracts for Academic Staff (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz “WissZeitVG”), which serves to promote a doctoral procedure or to support an academic career during the postdoctoral phase. The position is, depending on the qualification achieved to date, initially limited for a period of three years. An extension is generally possible within the time limits of the “WissZeitVG”.The research group, led by Prof. Dr.-Ing. Asif Ali Khan, works at the intersection of emerging computing architectures and compilers, using both conventional and emerging non-volatile memory technologies. Its research areas include in-memory and near-memory computing as well as the development of modeling and simulation frameworks and performance- and accuracy models for these novel systems. The group is particularly interested in hardware/software co-design and cross-stack optimizations for application domains including, and beyond, machine learning.Duties and responsibilities:• Scientific research in the broader area of novel computing architectures using conventional and emerging technologies• Publishing, presenting and disseminating research results• Teaching duties usually amounting to 4 teaching hours (SWS) per week during the lecture periodRecruitment requirements:• Excellent scientific university degree (Master or equivalent) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics or a related field• Completed Ph.D. for a postdoctoral position• Experience in circuit-level modeling and simulation (e.g., SPICE), ideally for compute-in-memory (CIM) architectures or unconventional computing paradigms such as probabilistic computing (p-bits)• Knowledge of emerging device technologies (e.g., non-volatile memories) and their device and circuit models• Experience in computer architecture and modeling and simulation tools (e.g., gem5)We also expect:• Independence and a solution-driven work attitude• Willingness to collaborate and work in a diverse environment, including on topics beyond your main research area• Fluency in English; German is a plusWe offer:• Flexible working hours and the individual option of mobile working• Wide range of health, counseling and prevention services• Attractive fringe benefits such as childcare facilities and sports activities• Opportunities for internal and external training and development• Additional benefits in accordance with the collective agreement of the federal states (TV-L), such as annual bonuses and capital-forming benefits as well as the VBL supplementary pension scheme• Research freedom to find and investigate topics of your own interest (within the scope of the group)Applications from women are particularly welcome and, in case of equal qualifications and experiences, will receive preferential treatment according to to state law (LGG), unless there are preponderant reasons to give preference to another applicant. Part-time employment is generally possible. Applications from disabled people with appropriate suitability are explicitly welcome. This also applies to people with equal opportunities in accordance with the German social law SGB IX.Please send your application documents (preferably in a single pdf file) using the Ref. No. 7242, by November 26, 2026 to eim-i-gs@uni-paderborn.de.
